data.one_liner: Display free and total disk space on Android and iOS devices.
data.what_it_does: It is a Flutter plugin that allows applications to query free and total disk space on the device, as well as free space for specific directory paths.
use_when: You need to check available storage space before downloading large files.
You want to display device disk space information to the user.
avoid_when: you need to support platforms other than Android and iOS.
you need advanced file management or database storage features.
strengths: Simple API to fetch total and free disk space.
Supports specific directory paths like application documents or external storage.
weaknesses: Only supports Android and iOS platforms.
Limited feature set focusing strictly on disk space querying.
